q: Pointing to a man, a woman said: He is the son of my mother's only daughter. How is the man related to the woman?
exp: The woman's mother's only daughter is the woman herself. Therefore, the man is her son.

q: Pointing to a girl, Ravi said: She is the daughter of my father's only son. How is the girl related to Ravi?
exp: Ravi's father's only son is Ravi himself. Therefore, the girl is Ravi's daughter.

q: Pointing to a woman, Arun said: She is the wife of my father's only son. How is the woman related to Arun?
exp: Arun's father's only son is Arun. The woman is therefore Arun's wife.

q: Pointing to a man, Neha said: He is the brother of my mother's only daughter. How is the man related to Neha?
exp: Neha's mother's only daughter is Neha herself. The man is her brother.

q: Pointing to a woman, Suresh said: She is the daughter of the only son of my grandfather. How is the woman related to Suresh?
exp: The only son of Suresh's grandfather is Suresh's father. His daughter is Suresh's sister.

q: Pointing to a boy, Priya said: He is the son of my only brother. How is the boy related to Priya?
exp: The son of Priya's brother is her nephew.

q: Pointing to a woman, Karan said: She is the mother of my mother's only son. Who is the woman to Karan?
exp: Karan's mother's only son is Karan himself. His mother is therefore the woman referred to.

q: Pointing to a man, Meena said: He is the father of my father's only daughter. How is the man related to Meena?
exp: Meena's father's only daughter is Meena herself. The father of Meena is therefore the man.

q: Pointing to a girl, Ajay said: She is the daughter of my sister's only brother. How is the girl related to Ajay?
exp: Ajay's sister's only brother is Ajay himself. Therefore, the girl is Ajay's daughter.

q: Pointing to a man, Kavya said: He is the husband of my mother's only daughter. How is the man related to Kavya?
exp: Kavya's mother's only daughter is Kavya herself. Her husband is the man referred to.

q: A + B means A is the brother of B. A - B means A is the sister of B. If P + Q - R, how is P related to R?
exp: P is brother of Q, and Q is sister of R. Therefore P and R are siblings, so P is R's brother.

q: A + B means A is the brother of B. A x B means A is the mother of B. If P x Q + R, how is P related to R?
exp: P is the mother of Q, and Q is the brother of R. Therefore P is also R's mother.

q: A @ B means A is the father of B, and A # B means A is the sister of B. If P @ Q # R, how is P related to R?
exp: P is father of Q. Q is sister of R, so P is also R's father.

q: A + B means A is the mother of B. A - B means A is the brother of B. If X + Y - Z, how is X related to Z?
exp: X is mother of Y, and Y is brother of Z. Therefore X is also Z's mother.

q: A @ B means A is the son of B. A # B means A is the wife of B. If P @ Q # R, how is P related to R?
exp: P is son of Q, and Q is wife of R. Therefore P is R's son.

q: Pointing to a man, Ritu said: He is the only son of my mother's only son. How is the man related to Ritu?
exp: Ritu's mother's only son is Ritu's brother. His only son is Ritu's nephew.

q: Pointing to a woman, Mohan said: She is the daughter of the wife of my only son. How is the woman related to Mohan?
exp: Mohan's only son's wife is his daughter-in-law. Her daughter is Mohan's granddaughter.

q: Pointing to a boy, Sunita said: He is the only son of the only daughter of my mother. How is the boy related to Sunita?
exp: Sunita's mother's only daughter is Sunita herself. Her only son is therefore Sunita's son.

q: Pointing to a woman, Raj said: She is the sister of the only daughter of my father's only son. How is the woman related to Raj?
exp: Raj's father's only son is Raj. His only daughter is Raj's daughter. The sister of that daughter is also Raj's daughter.

q: Pointing to a man, Anu said: He is the father of the only child of my mother's only daughter. How is the man related to Anu?
exp: Anu's mother's only daughter is Anu. The father of Anu's only child is her husband.

q: A family has P and Q as brothers. Q is the father of R. R is the sister of S. How is S related to P?
exp: P and Q are brothers. Q's children R and S are therefore P's nephew or niece. Since S's gender is not specified, the relation is nephew or niece.

q: A is the mother of B. B is the brother of C. C is the mother of D. How is A related to D?
exp: A is mother of B, and B and C are siblings. C is mother of D. Therefore A is D's grandmother.

q: P is the brother of Q. Q is the mother of R. R is the sister of S. How is P related to S?
exp: Q is S's mother, and P is Q's brother. Therefore P is S's maternal uncle.

q: X is the daughter of Y. Y is the brother of Z. Z is the mother of W. How is X related to W?
exp: Y and Z are siblings. Their children X and W are therefore cousins.

q: A is the son of B. C is the daughter of B. D is the husband of C. How is D related to A?
exp: C is A's sister, and D is C's husband. Therefore D is A's brother-in-law.

q: M is the father of N. N is the father of O. O is the mother of P. How is M related to P?
exp: M is father of N, N is father of O, and O is mother of P. Therefore M is P's great-grandfather.

q: R is the daughter of S. S is the son of T. T is the mother of U. How is R related to U?
exp: S is the son of T, and R is S's daughter. U is also a child of T. Therefore R and U are cousins.

q: K is the sister of L. L is the father of M. M is the brother of N. How is K related to N?
exp: K is L's sister, while L is the father of M and N. Therefore K is N's aunt.

q: A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. D is the brother of C. How is D related to A?
exp: B is child of C, and A is B's brother, so A is also child of C. D is C's brother, making D A's uncle.

q: P is the mother of Q. Q is the wife of R. S is the son of R. How is P related to S?
exp: P is Q's mother, Q is R's wife, and S is R's son. Therefore P is S's grandmother.

q: V is the father of W. W is the sister of X. X is the father of Y. How is V related to Y?
exp: V is father of W, and W and X are siblings. X is father of Y, so V is Y's grandfather.

q: If P is the son of Q, Q is the daughter of R, and R is the mother of S, how is S related to P?
exp: Q is child of R, and S is also child of R. Therefore Q and S are siblings. P is Q's son, making S P's maternal uncle or aunt.

q: A man said, The woman standing there is the daughter of the wife of my father's only son. If the man is not the only son of his father, how is the woman related to him?
exp: The father's only son is someone else, not the speaker. The wife of that son is the man's sister-in-law, and her daughter is his niece.

q: A is the mother of B. C is the father of A. D is the mother of C. How is D related to B?
exp: D is C's mother, C is A's father, and A is B's mother. Therefore D is B's great-grandmother.

q: P is the son of Q. R is the daughter of Q. S is the son of P. How is R related to S?
exp: P and R are siblings. S is P's son, so R is S's aunt.

q: A is the daughter of B. C is the son of D. B and D are brothers. How is A related to C?
exp: B and D are brothers. Their children A and C are cousins.

q: M is the wife of N. O is the brother of N. P is the daughter of O. How is M related to P?
exp: M is married to N, and O is N's brother. P is O's daughter. Therefore M is P's aunt by marriage.

q: R is the father of S. T is the mother of S. U is the brother of R. How is U related to S?
exp: U is the brother of S's father R. Therefore U is S's paternal uncle.

q: Pointing to a photograph, Deepa said: This man's mother is the only daughter of my mother's mother. How is the man related to Deepa?
exp: Deepa's mother's mother is her maternal grandmother. Her only daughter is Deepa's mother. Therefore the man's mother is Deepa's mother, making him Deepa's brother.
